reviewer: Independent internal AI-assisted publication and preservation review agent
review_scope: Static workflow, authentication, artifact closure, publication claims, initial-run traceability and preservation. Mathematical review is separate. Final-head CI and post-merge live readback are separate gates.
authorization: User-authorized GitHub publication and CI/merge; this review performed only GitHub GETs before writing this unreferenced review blob. No refs, branches, pull requests or external publications were mutated by this reviewer.
approval: No static publication or preservation blocker. These exact heads are approved for merging once the root verifies successful required CI for the exact reviewed heads and confirms fresh bases remain compatible. No approval is asserted here for an unreviewed changed head.

workflow.checkout: Blob-filtered sparse checkout of the new capsule, archive, evidence directory and six retained upstream capsules.
workflow.execution_isolation: Python -I -S -B; explicit source authentication precedes numerical imports. Node checkers use built-in modules and read files/write stdout only.
workflow.hardcap: Native LEVELS=(64,128,256), unchanged from initial source. No mesh escalation or unbounded retry.
workflow.outputs: Fresh runner temporary directory; upload-artifact retains intended receipts/results for 30 days. No git push, deploy, package install or token-bearing custom command.
workflow.live_readback: On main push only: public unauthenticated GETs to two owned GitHub repositories and three owned GitHub Pages URLs; checks 22 capsule/archive files, 4 edited source files, and 3 full live HTML documents including all retained markers. Three-page retry loop has six attempts and 10-second spacing; HTTP timeout is 20 seconds.

source_authentication.hash_control: Pure JavaScript SHA256 implementation checked against standard empty-string and abc vectors.
source_authentication.runner: Both normal and optimized modes regenerate all five result files; every byte is compared across modes and against the authenticated frozen references; required accuracy pass is explicit in wrapper.

archive.static_validator_review: Pins byte length and SHA256; unique exact 21-member closure; CRC; unencrypted non-symlink files; every member size/hash and byte equality with source; archive and external pins rechecked after replay.
archive.reviewer_limitation: GitHub connector binary fetch is unavailable: blob fetch rejects UTF-8 decoding and contents/base64 returned empty content for this >1MB file. This reviewer independently verified the Git object and size, source hashes, and validator code; final CI must establish archive bytes/CRC execution.

initial_evidence.stored_metadata_status: Completed success; one workflow run and one check, both at initial source head.
initial_evidence.native_initial_receipt: Normal/optimized REPORT, PROFILES and EVALUATED_CANDIDATE hashes identical.

publication_claims.observed_claim: Conditional continuous five-mean C1 approximation with first coupled feedback and shell lift, complete scaled X bound below 1.6090323e28 and target 1e29.
explicit_limits: No pointwise second-derivative Einstein residual certificate
No physical Big Bang origin inference
Internal AI-assisted review is not external peer review or formalization

remaining_runtime_gates: Exact reviewed science/package head CI must pass CRC, archive/source equality, native golden replay in both modes and independent audits.
Required shared-site checks must pass for its exact reviewed head.
After merge, confirm canonical merge identities and successful bounded public source/archive/live-page readback; keep that evidence separate from this static approval.
remote_mutations_by_reviewer: Only creation of this unreferenced JSON blob; no ref updates.
